items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: I've done a bunch of recordings with Flip, appeared with him 6 weeks last year at Michael's Pub in New York

ctx.x: Just quickly, I have one of the late party programs in front of me. For one week we had -- we had for a week long, but each night you would get to hear George Duvivier, and Jack Lesberg and Milt Hinton on bases -- Pee Wee Irwin, Clark Terry, Wild Bill Davison, John Best, on trumpets -- and one of Dr. Fulcher's great loves on tenor saxophone, and personally, is Flip Phillips. He's one of mine, too. I might mention here.

I've done a bunch of recordings with Flip, appeared with him 6 weeks last year at Michael's Pub in New York -- also jazz concerts around New York, and Milt Hinton was in on some of those. Milt, you were with me in Michael's Pub, weren't you, with Flip, among others?

To continue with the artists at the Odessa party, we also had on that same program, on trombones, one that's always with us, the superb Carl Fontana. We had Lou McGarity until his death. And a wonderful Texas trombonist, Ashley Alexander, Jr. We had Ed Hubl on trombone -- another really great unsung hero musically. Let's see, there's myself on drums, and Duke Hanna, and Mousey Alexander, Bobby Rosengarden - that's a motley crew!
